scope.deduplication: Exact SHA-256 within document kind for metrics; copies are kept in document index.
scope.projects: Top-level source directories, not runtime versions.
scope.pages: Physical chapter page occurrences, counted by document plus XML position.
scope.source_locations: 1-based opening tag position from Expat. Examples retain excerpts of attribute values.
scope.version_identification: Player version undetermined. Version attributes are inventoried as declared.
scope.lexical_forms: Heuristics based on XML spelling only. Media paths come from known media fields and file extensions. Camel-case on-prefixed attributes are recorded lexically.
scope.discovery_limit: XML data only. No scripts, media, styles or external target files opened. No scenes built.

scope.documents: Distinct parsed chapters and configurations from documents.
scope.callback_syntax: Nonempty on-prefixed camel-case attributes. TypeScript parser reports source syntax, statement order and calls, including nested expressions. No source expression was evaluated.
scope.callback_targets: Quoted #id strings compared literally with id attributes in the same source page. Empty matches do not imply the runtime target is missing.
scope.transition_syntax: Standalone tween elements and destination attributes. destination is inspected as a field list; diagnostics describe that reading only, not the source reader grammar.
scope.literal_match: Exact declared id in the same source page. Sequencies only identify XML ancestry. A filename stem candidate is a clue to a reader-generated identifier, not a verified identity or a runtime target.
scope.navigation: Locations are opening tags, with 1-based line and column numbers. sequence_line and source_action describe the nearest containing sequency and sequencyAction if present.
